desc: nikomi hamburg, a thick oval hamburg steak simmered in a rich glossy dark-brown demi-glace sauce with sliced mushrooms and onion, in a shallow dish

ja: 和風おろしハンバーグ
desc: wafu oroshi hamburg, a browned oval hamburg steak topped with a mound of white grated daikon, a shiso leaf and a little clear brown ponzu, on a plate
cheese hamburg, a thick browned oval hamburg steak with a slice of melted yellow cheese draped over it and demi-glace sauce around, with corn and French fries, on a plate
natto mixed with kimchi in a small bowl: sticky brown fermented soybeans with stringy threads tossed with red-orange napa cabbage kimchi pieces, a few green onion rings
Japanese homemade chicken ham: a rolled poached chicken breast cut into round pale pink-white slices fanned on a small plate, moist and smooth, no skin
ajitama marinated eggs: two soft-boiled eggs with smooth light-brown soy-stained whites, one cut in half showing a jammy deep orange yolk, on a small plate
jaga butter: one whole steamed potato in its skin split open with a cross cut, fluffy pale yellow inside, a melting pat of butter on top, on a small plate
multigrain rice in a rice bowl: cooked white rice speckled with small purple-brown, yellow and beige grains (barley, millet, black rice), slightly pinkish tint
mentaiko udon: thick white udon noodles in a bowl without soup, tossed with pink-orange spicy cod roe and melted butter, topped with thin strips of dark nori and a green shiso leaf
tantan nabe for one in a small clay pot: creamy orange-beige sesame broth with red chili oil drops, minced pork, napa cabbage, garlic chives, bean sprouts and tofu cubes
anmitsu Japanese dessert in a glass bowl: clear agar jelly cubes, a scoop of smooth dark red bean paste, boiled red peas, canned mandarin segments and white peach slices, dark brown kuromitsu syrup
ginger ale in a tall clear glass with ice: pale golden-amber sparkling soda with small bubbles
